reproduction_target: The computational RRBS DNA-methylation analysis: from raw Illumina HiSeqX reads (NCBI BioProject PRJNA1369104) through TrimGalore trimming, Bismark alignment/methylation extraction against xbMytCali1.0.p (GCF_021869535.1), CpG feature annotation, PCA/mixed models, edgeR differential methylation, feature-enrichment tests, and GO enrichment (GOseq, GO-MWU). The reciprocal-transplant field experiment (Gleason et al. 2018 samples), DNA extraction, RRBS library construction and sequencing are wet-lab and out of scope.
granularity_note: Coarse step list built from Methods prose only (Stage-1 triage). One step per named tool/analysis invocation; pre-trim and post-trim FastQC/MultiQC runs are merged into a single QC step because they are the same tools at the same versions. Repo source files were NOT read line-by-line; the GitHub landing page + README prose were used only to confirm that scripts covering the pipeline and the R analyses are deposited. Several analyses (arrayQualityMetrics outlier test, GO-MWU details, interaction-model comparison, CpG-aligned-read QC) are explicitly deferred to Supplemental Materials, which was not retrieved at this stage.

steps.label: Reciprocal transplant field experiment at Hopkins Marine Station (juvenile M. californianus, exposed/protected origin x transplant, iButton loggers, 1 month, shell-length measurement); samples from Gleason et al. 2018

Genomic DNA extraction (Qiagen Puregene Tissue Core Kit A) and RRBS library construction (MspI digest, end-repair/A-tail, NEBNext methylated adapters, EZ DNA Methylation-Gold bisulfite conversion, 16-cycle PCR, SPRI clean-ups)
Illumina HiSeqX 150 bp paired-end sequencing, four lanes per run (USC Genome Core)
Read quality assessment before and after trimming — FastQC v0.12.1 + MultiQC v1.25.2
Adapter/quality trimming — TrimGalore! v0.6.10 with --rrbs and paired-end, plus hard trim retaining 65 bp from the 5' end of both reads; per-sample concatenation of the four lanes
Bisulfite conversion of the reference genome xbMytCali1.0.p (GCF_021869535.1) via bismark_genome_preparation (C->T and G->A) — Bismark v0.24.2
Paired-end alignment of trimmed reads to the bisulfite-converted reference — Bismark v0.24.2, minimum score threshold 'L,0,-0.6', stringency 1
Methylation calling with bismark_methylation_extractor and merging of top/bottom strand coverage files (Bismark v0.24.2)

Genomic-feature annotation of CpG sites (intron/exon/promoter/UTR/intergenic) — agat v1.2.0 to add introns and UTRs to the NCBI GCF_021869535 .gff, genomation v1.34.0 and GenomicRanges v1.54.1 in R v4.3.2; promoters defined as 1 kb upstream of the first exon
Methylation-proportion matrix for all 65 samples, missing-value imputation with mice v3.16.0, and PCA with prcomp (R stats v4.3.2)
Linear mixed-effects model of PCA loadings on tissue type and final shell length with sample ID as random effect — lmer, lme4 v1.1-35.5
Mantel matrix-correlation test between Euclidean methylation distance on PC axes 1-19 and a binary individual-identity matrix — mantel, vegan 2.6-10

Sample filtering: arrayQualityMetrics distance-between-arrays outlier test in R (three gill samples removed) followed by selection of the five largest-library samples per origin-by-transplant-by-tissue group (n = 40)

Genome-wide mean CpG methylation model — beta-distributed GLMM with logit link, fixed effects tissue/origin/transplant, sample ID random effect, coverage filter >=3 reads in 14 of 20 samples per tissue — glmmTMB 1.1.10

Differential methylation analysis on Bismark coverage files — edgeR v4.0.16 glmFit negative-binomial GLMs per tissue with origin site, transplant site and shell length as fixed effects; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR alpha < 0.05
Post-hoc analysis of log2FC values — two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (wilcox.test), linear models (lm) on mean and absolute log2FC, and Pearson correlations between tissues (cor.test), R v4.3.2
Genomic-feature over/under-representation of DM CpGs — two-sided Fisher's exact tests (fisher.test) with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, plus binomial-logit GLMs (glm) for among-feature differences, R v4.3.2
GO enrichment of differentially methylated genes per tissue — GOseq v1.54.0; DM genes defined as genes with >=1 significant DM CpG and >=3 CpGs in the coverage-filtered dataset within the gene region

Rank-based GO analysis with adaptive clustering and Mann-Whitney U on mean gene-wide log2FC — GO-MWU (https://github.com/z0on/GO_MWU), no version/commit stated, detailed parameters deferred to Supplemental Materials

Unexecuted; declared environment statically valid but not verified as the env that produced the results. Under-claims by construction: Stage-1 cannot credit an undeclared-but-present dependency, and has_validated_env_capture=false so this ratio is a ceiling artefact, not a per-paper score. n_exact_capture_unexecuted=0, n_fetch_required=0.
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 14/16 (88%) readiness upper bound at the Stage-1 RI ceiling ((n_R-star + n_RI)/|S| with n_R-star forced to 0). Never read as 'reproducible'. Two steps (C10 arrayQualityMetrics, C16 GO-MWU) fall to NI on an unstated tool version; both are recoverable if the deposited scripts or the Supplemental Materials name the versions.
headline.coverage: 16 computational steps scored from Methods prose; 3 wet-lab steps recorded as OOS and excluded from |S|. Computational coverage |S|/(|S|+|W|) = 16/19 (84%). Repo source files not read (Stage-1); Supplemental Materials not retrieved.

gaps.how_to_close: State the arrayQualityMetrics package version and pin GO-MWU to a commit SHA or vendored copy in the deposited repository.

gaps.missing: 2a/env-closure - every other tool carries an exact prose pin (FastQC v0.12.1, MultiQC v1.25.2, TrimGalore v0.6.10, Bismark v0.24.2, agat v1.2.0, R v4.3.2, genomation v1.34.0, GenomicRanges v1.54.1, mice v3.16.0, lme4 v1.1-35.5, vegan 2.6-10, glmmTMB 1.1.10, edgeR v4.0.16, GOseq v1.54.0), but the pins are scattered prose with no interpreter+channel+platform closure. The GitHub landing page and README show no renv.lock, environment.yml, Dockerfile, conda spec, or sessionInfo output.

gaps.missing: 13 - the reference assembly xbMytCali1.0.p (GCF_021869535.1) and its .gff annotation are pinned in prose with a versioned RefSeq accession, but whether the deposited pipeline fetches that exact versioned artifact in code (class A) or consumes a user-supplied local path (class B) cannot be determined without reading the workflow. env_capture_class left n/a per the Stage-1 rule.

gaps.missing: 10 - the reciprocal transplant field experiment, DNA extraction/RRBS library preparation and Illumina sequencing are wet-lab; they are recorded as OOS and excluded from the computational denominator. The transplant itself was conducted in a prior study (Gleason et al. 2018), so the biological material cannot be regenerated from this paper alone.
gaps.how_to_close: Not applicable - wet-lab is outside NASEM 2019 reproducibility scope for this survey.
